Comparison does not change configuration, enable reports or execute controls.

mmsTls.instructions: This identity belongs only to the current MMS channel instance. An independent PKI manages its key. Rotate or revoke material through a complete channel update and new configuration revision. Changed or expired material and failed revocation checks stop the session. This does not establish complete IEC 62351 conformance.

control.cancelRecorded: The intent is durably recorded. A selected object remains occupied until its correlated Cancel response. This record does not mean a physical action was undone.

control.noObservation: No current field feedback is bound to this operation. Requested values are never displayed as observations.
control.reconcileHint: Record independent verification and release the object. The original indeterminate result remains in the audit history.
control.evidence: Field verification, findings and record references

states.releasePendingLate: Operate result recorded; selection release unresolved
